AppController blocks arming for nondefault legacy software zeros until all hardware centers are acknowledged. Chat/media/dual-mic/wake/mouth remain.

controller_adaptations.command: Reject inactive web/voice/gamepad input without changing upstream command limits.

transport_overlays.reason: Repair Router method registry after serial reconnect even when $/version still responds. Same-owner registration verified idempotent on Router 0.11.0.

mcu_compatibility.calibration: Upstream hardware-center DQL2/DQA1/DQR2 and DQV2/DQS3 packets; legacy software centers are not applied.

integration: Pinned master motion math, eight ONNX policies, motion web pages, STM32 protocol and nonblocking Bridge patch. Preserve AI, gamepad and voice ownership, calibration migration, speech-mouth exclusion and independent ToF registration on each Bridge connection. Voice Stand enters sit-to-stand through the existing model/history, preserves an active stand transition, and cancels kick before requesting walk mode. Repair method registration every 2 s on the Bridge supervisor; normal 100 Hz control, motion models and wire ABI remain pinned to master. Servo gains are user-controlled: no automatic writes during App/voice startup, restart, MCU boot, arming or exclusive-mode transitions. Manual saved settings and read-only runtime diagnostics remain available. Saved settings, zero positions, normal motion math and all web assets remain unchanged.
calibration: Keep old data/zero_pos.json unchanged as a backup only. Hardware centers live in each servo. Per-robot data/hardware-centers.json records acknowledged migration against the legacy file digest; failed/partial calibration cannot enable motion.

audio_cue_overlay.reason: Use 300 ms cues with 2× PCM amplitude for send and 3× for reply completion relative to the 0.2.34 assets.

local_aec_overlay.reason: Continuous local reference, compatible cloud abort, reply-generation isolation and optional AEC playback headroom; stable motion/web/MCU unchanged.

static_imu_calibration.integration: Per-device cached body-frame rotation and static gyro zero before the unchanged upstream SignalFilter. Load once at process start; no automatic recalibration or file I/O in feedback. Raw diagnostics preserved; missing file retains baseline, invalid file blocks arming. No MCU, policy math or original web changes.

runtime_gains_overlay.scope: User-controlled per-servo gains, including the mouth. No gain writes on App/voice startup, respawn, MCU boot, arming, exclusive-mode transitions or timeout. Manual saved settings and on-demand runtime readback remain.

forward_avoidance_overlay.integration: Existing MCP stand/move/pick/roulade plus Sit, LeftKick, RightKick and SetWalkingMode. Cached forward-only walking/roller input limit; front ToF slows/stops travel, missing/stale/invalid measurements stop forward only. Cancel blocked MCP jobs/queue and require new command after recovery; held controls must release. Preserve torque, core controller math, special-model inputs, MCU, all model files and original web assets. Background monitor renews its private read-only lease; no hardware RPC or file I/O in the control loop. MCP comment and wire-size test use verified CN packet budget 16000 bytes, 60 tools, including JSON escaping/envelope.

tof_mcp_outcome_overlay.integration: Read-only Duck.GetToF via authenticated local IPC returns the 5 Hz sensor grid and cached forward status, each with frame sequence/age. Expected obstacle/sensor pauses return successful MCP calls with blocked execution; retain actual parameter, permission and motion feedback/transport errors. Preflight, queued and racing forward blocks do not set a false motion error. No changes to controller math, guard thresholds, web assets, ONNX, audio or MCU.

forward_distance_defaults.scope: User-selected normal walking distances. Retain faster Roller distance margin, invalid/stale sensor stop, torque retention, three-frame release and new-command requirement.

previous_profile.scope: Fixed-speed ordinary forward entry without speed argument. Explicit slow/numeric Move keeps the supplied speed; omitted Move speed uses directional defaults. Phone RemoteMove, motion core, ToF rules, models and MCU unchanged. Restart the voice child to refresh the tool catalog.

normal_forward_defaults.scope: All MCP Move directions default to 0.1 m/s and reject speeds above 0.15, including Roller. Forward normal/fast profiles select 0.1/0.15. Explicit values within the cap are preserved. Web/core limits, angular rates, RemoteMove percentage mapping, ToF, models and MCU unchanged.

ai_binding_overlay.scope: Explicit browser selection of cn/global immediately saves via same-origin POST and voice IPC, then reconnects voice. No additional Apply button. Pending saves suppress repeated switches; failed or lost responses reconcile the actual persisted selection. Preserve identity, conversation language, audio and motion. Platform links, UI language and phone provisioning never select a cloud automatically. Initial UI language follows the accessing browser system language (Chinese locales use Chinese, all others English), ignoring persisted language overrides. Manual toggles are page-local and never change the cloud.
ai_binding_overlay.validation: Region HTTP and parent/voice IPC tests retained. UI lifecycle checks cover immediate save, duplicate suppression, rollback, lost-response reconciliation, close/reopen during save, stale connection isolation, idempotency, first selection, custom URL and preserved language. MCU, models and motion math unchanged. 13 locale/old-preference cases, temporary toggle and system languagechange checks passed.

speaker_test_overlay.scope: Add an explicit speaker-test control to the left of live microphone listening. Play bundled duck calls through the existing media audio handoff using source=duck; preserve music/upload/recording/TTS sources, uploaded content, volume, MCU and all motion code. No playback on page load. Pending requests suppress overlap; users can stop their test, and natural completion restores controls. Reconnect chat after media releases the device.
speaker_test_overlay.validation: Node VM cockpit lifecycle checks plus AudioHandoff and Runtime tests cover play/stop/finish, stale polling, errors, duplicate clicks, missing device, zh/en state, unchanged volume/uploads and chat resume.

startup_guide_overlay.scope: Explain one-time setup, boot autostart, ordered network/voice duck sounds and the xiao-ya wake phrase in both READMEs and the AI binding dialog. Browser-local sound examples use the actual connection cue kinds and software gain. Previews never command Duck or write its configuration, and stop on close, hide, page exit or a new selection. Runtime autostart, actual connection sound playback, motion, models, calibration and MCU are unchanged.
